_comment: Which group code run.py uses (--code NAME; default below). Each code has its own clone next to this repo and its own conda env, because both install a package and commands named 'cboamd'. In config paths, {code} means that code's repo folder.

cboamd._comment: Public release, github.com/flickgroup/cboamd (the paper's code). No 'ff' driver.

pdm._comment: Group development repo polaritonic_deep_md; all runs before 2026-11-10 used this.
